name: mage-book-build-tooling
description: Node-only tooling for the MAGE book build. NOT part of the stdlib-only catalog.py / site build — used by `build_book.py` to render ```mermaid fences to inline SVG at BUILD time (mermaid-cli / mmdc), and by the responsive-layout + console-error served-page smoke gates (headless Chrome via Puppeteer). The book PDF is rendered separately by the print-native Typst path (`--pdf`), which needs no Node. The web book build stays dependency-free EXCEPT for the mermaid-cli SVG pre-render (guarded: a page with no mermaid fence needs no Node).
